If possible, please attach any existing benchmark artifacts and a proposed MAP spreadsheet. I'll loop in our platform lead if we need deeper infra discussion.

Claire / team —

Quick interim update after the Feb 4–5 sweeps. We ran the evaluation on our dedicated infra using the prompt set you shared (thank you). Attached is the raw CSV (benchmark_results_acme_20260205.csv) and a short PDF summary (model_variant_eval_summary_20260206.pdf). Below are the high-level numbers and our read on quality/perf tradeoffs for your target workload.

Test conditions (brief):
- Hardware: 8x A100 80GB equivalent nodes, single-request routing, KV cache warm for prefix tokens
- Payloads: short (30 tokens) and medium (100 tokens)
- Concurrency sweep: 1, 4, 8, 16 sustained for 10-minute windows

Key numeric results (median / p95 / notes):
- RW-Compact-7B-4q (lowest latency, quantized)
  - TTFT (30t): 120ms (p95 180ms)
  - Latency (100t): p50 220ms / p95 370ms
  - Sustained throughput @8 conc: 38 req/sec
  - Observations: Meets your TTFT p50 target; p95 for 100 tokens slightly above your 350ms target at 370ms. Cost per 1k tokens: ~ $0.22 (estimated).

- RW-Opt-13B-8bit (balanced)
  - TTFT (30t): 165ms (p95 240ms)
  - Latency (100t): p50 280ms / p95 420ms
  - Sustained throughput @8 conc: 22 req/sec
  - Observations: Better quality than 7B in our automated evals (EM + human spot checks), but p95 exceeds your 350ms target for 100-token responses at default config. Cost per 1k tokens: ~ $0.48 (estimated).

- RW-Open-XL-30B (highest quality)
  - TTFT (30t): 240ms (p95 360ms)
  - Latency (100t): p50 420ms / p95 680ms
  - Sustained throughput @8 conc: 9 req/sec
  - Observations: Best quality on your evaluation suite but does not meet latency targets; throughput is limited. Cost per 1k tokens: ~ $1.35 (estimated).

Recommendation: For Acme's pilot where both latency and cost matter, RW-Compact-7B-4q provides the closest fit to the stated SLOs — it meets TTFT p50 and sustained throughput and is close on p95 for short responses. If quality regressions are unacceptable on specific prompts, we recommend a hybrid route: default RW-Compact-7B-4q with fallback routing to RW-Opt-13B-8bit for a small subset of prompts flagged by your prompt classifier (or per-route config).

Planned next steps:
- Feb 7: we can run a tuned 7B variant (small sequence-level quantization tweaks) to try to shave ~20–30ms p95.
- Feb 8–11: if you want to prioritize quality, we'll run an expanded 13B tuning pass and provide A/B quality samples for your reviewers.

Files attached: benchmark_results_acme_20260205.csv, model_variant_eval_summary_20260206.pdf

Let us know whether you want the tuned 7B pass this weekend. If you approve, we'll schedule and deliver results by Feb 7.

Thanks,
